summary: A 2.4 to 2.6 upgrade migrates only complete auth configs (LDAP server URL; GitHub/Azure AD key and secret; OIDC key, secret, endpoint; RADIUS/TACACS+ host). Before: create a local admin, enable the local authenticator, take a full backup; after: update IdP callback URLs and re-add LDAPS custom certificates.
questions: Why wasn't my LDAP authentication migrated to platform gateway?
What should I do before upgrading authentication to 2.6?
Do I need to update callback URLs after upgrading?

answer_card.title: Authentication migration 2.4 → 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
Only **complete** configs migrate:
- LDAP: server URL
- GitHub, Azure AD: key and secret
- OIDC: key, secret and endpoint
- RADIUS, TACACS+: host

Before: create a local admin and test login, enable the local authenticator, take a full backup.

After: update IdP **callback URLs**, re-establish **LDAPS custom certificates** manually.
